resources.string: Live time since, or until, any date. Choose the style, colors and transparency for each widget.
Add a widget to your home screen

1. Tap the button above, or long-press an empty spot on your home screen and choose Widgets.
2. Pick Time Since and place it.
3. Choose the date, style, colors and transparency, then tap Save widget.
4. Repeat for as many widgets as you like. Each one keeps its own date and look.
A big live clock with today\'s date. Choose 12 or 24 hour, seconds, colors and transparency.
Two or three cities, each with its own live time and weekday. Choose the cities, colors and transparency.
Up to four events in one widget, each with the days left. Birthdays and anniversaries can repeat every year.
Android cannot redraw a widget every second. Days, hours and the rest refresh every hour, while minutes and seconds tick live. Tap a widget any time to change it.
